About street numbers & privacy

Gridway numbers are app references, separate from official street names and addresses. East and West street names have separate references. Numbered roads cover Manhattan; they do not provide a walking route.

Street shapes: NYC Open Data, Street Centerline, downloaded October 19, 2026. Road segments with the same name share one number. Map: © OpenStreetMap contributors.

Searches are sent to Komoot’s Photon service when you press search. Location is requested once when you tap the button; map providers receive the viewed area. Opening Google Maps shares your chosen start and destination with Google. Nothing is stored by this app.
